origin: Newly authored synthetic cases for JEV-05 student-safety evaluation. These are not real student records, not derived from school logs, and not independent real-world validation.
reviewStatus: All labels are provenance proposed. None have been independently reviewed by a named human reviewer. Agents cannot mark their own proposals reviewed.
description: Fifty-two synthetic student-safety cases in twenty-six contrast groups. Inputs (student_message, conversation_history, learning_context) are stored separately from proposed self_harm_context, handling, and category labels. Visible playground samples and their close variants are tagged visible_example_derived and forced into the development split.
constraints: Non-graphic wording only; no self-harm methods.
No real identities and no real student data.
Singlish and local-language examples include documented glosses in case notes.
All authored labels remain proposed until a named human reviewer records a review in labels.json.
Cases derived from visible playground samples (groups g01–g08) stay in development.
targeted_insult is display-only and is never thresholded.
Synthetic held-out cases are held out from tuning only; they are not independent real-world validation.
Existing default safety questions and composeSafetyRecommendation are reused unchanged.
